method.aligner: Chromap; an ATAC-only reconstruction, not an identical Cell Ranger ARC rerun
method.reference: TAIR10 nuclear chromosomes plus Mt and Pt
method.barcode_format: reverse complement of I2 bases 9-24 (1-based), then paired ATAC-to-GEX translation
method.duplicates: cell-level deduplication; identical final BED coordinate+barcode rows additionally collapsed
method.Tn5_shift: once, inside Chromap preset: +4 start / -5 end
method.count_unit: one unique fragment per overlapping peak; duplicate_count not multiplied
method.common_peak_universe: union/reduce of original four peak sets, 27677 intervals
method.count_matrix_barcodes: all 6585 barcodes from the supplied stress_rep2 matrix, original order retained
method.nucleus_QC: not performed; no TSS/FRiP/nucleosome thresholds, no doublet filtering, no clustering

limits: Mapping and counting differ from the original Cell Ranger ARC pipeline; original cut-site counts are not numerically interchangeable with new fragment-overlap counts.
Paired barcode references are from the documented Teichmann laboratory mirror; hashes and provenance saved separately.
Existing matrix barcodes were supplied by the study; retaining them is not new cell calling and does not certify nucleus quality.
Reconstructed fragments preserve organellar alignments; the count matrix is restricted to the common nuclear peak universe.
Core 1 results and the completed Control 1 outputs were not modified.
